## Frequently Asked Questions

What is music therapy?

Music therapy, an allied health profession, "is the clinical and evidence-based use of music
interventions to accomplish individualized goals within a therapeutic relationship by a credentialed
professional who has completed an approved music therapy program."

What are the health benefits of music therapy?

Music therapy is used to aid in physical discomfort by improving respiration, lowering blood
pressure, improved cardiac output, reduced heart rate and relaxed muscle tension.

What are the limitations of music therapy?

Music therapy is generally very safe and has no side effects. But very loud music or particular
types of music might irritate some people or make them feel uncomfortable. The music might trigger
strong reactions or evoke memories which could range from pleasant to painful.

What kind of music is used in music therapy?

Songs by Queen, Pink Floyd and Bob Marley are among the most effective for music therapy patients, a
UK study has found.

* ## [ For Publishers ][14]
  
  Learn about deposit options for journals and publishers and the PMC selection process.
* ## [ For Developers ][15]
  
  Find tools for bulk download, text mining, and other machine analysis.

## 12.2 million articles are archived in PMC.

Content provided in part by:
* 3027
  Full Participation Journals
  
  Journals deposit the complete contents of each issue or volume.
* 249
  NIH Portfolio Journals
  
  Journals deposit all NIH-funded articles as defined by the NIH Public Access Policy.
* 44
  Selective Deposit Programs
  
  Publisher deposits a subset of articles from a collection of journals.

How do I enrol in a course?

To register for a course, simply select the course you wish to attend and choose a payment method.
We offer a secure interface to proceed with the payment, and once your payment is validated, you
will receive an email with your login and password. This will give you access to your course
materials and you can start your training immediately.

What should I do if I forget my login details?

If you lose your login details, don’t worry. You can send a request to our support team at
[[email protected]][31] and we will assist you in retrieving your login information. However, we
highly advise you to write down your login details as soon as you receive them to avoid any issues.

How long does it take to complete a course?

With our online courses, you have unlimited access to the training programs for life. You can start
your training whenever you want, and there is no time limit to complete it. However, we recommend
allowing between 30 minutes and 2 hours to complete each module, depending on the complexity of the
course.

Do I need to travel to attend the courses?

No, all of our training is conducted online. With your login, the tools and teaching aids are
accessible from any computer, tablet or smartphone. The courses are accessible from anywhere, as
long as you have an Internet connection.

If I change my mind, can I cancel my registration?

Yes, you have a withdrawal period of 30 days from the validation of the payment. If you are not
satisfied with your course, you can cancel your registration and receive a refund without any
justification.

How am I evaluated during training?

Throughout the course, you will find a quiz at the end of each module. While these quizzes are not
mandatory, we highly recommend taking them to prepare you for the final exam.

At the end of the course, there will be a final exam in the form of a multiple-choice questionnaire.
To validate it, you must obtain 80% of correct answers. If you score less than 80%, you will have
the opportunity to retake the exam. Once you pass the exam, you can print your certification online.

What materials are used for training?

Our courses consist of downloadable PDF documents and audio material. These materials are accessible
through your login, and you can download and review them as many times as you like.

the site. If an audio or PDF file is difficult to read, try opening it in another browser or pausing
it. Depending on your internet speed, it may take some time to load. Make sure you keep your browser
up to date and check your plug-ins. Also, remember to clear your caches and cookies from time to
time. If you continue to have issues, contact our support team for assistance.

### Introduction to Tuning Forks


Anyone starting out with tuning forks can be easily confused by the terminology and various types of
forks available. This introductory video will get you started. It answers some of your basic
questions on selecting a tuning fork for sound therapy. If you want to try tuning forks to see if
they are right for you, a great way to begin with with our [Starter Set][37].

### About Our Tuning Forks
* Our tuning forks are **made in the USA**
* Our tuning forks are **machined**, not molded
* Our tuning forks are made from **aluminum alloy**

All of our tuning forks are manufactured especially for sound therapy and health care professionals.
Our tuning forks are made from impact resistant aluminum alloy making them approximately 26% harder
and giving them a ring time up to 20% longer than other manufacturers. They are tuned to within .5%
of the indicated frequency at 20 degrees Celsius, 68 degrees Fahrenheit. Omnivos tuning forks are
subject to at least three inspection processes... [Read more][38]

### Education Center

Visit our [education center][39] to learn how to select the right tuning fork for you and how to use
them.

#### Looking for a practitioner?

Visit our [Practitioner Page.][40]

### How to Use Tuning Forks


Weighted tuning forks have round on the end of the each prong are used on the body and by the ears.
They are used by those who are experiencing joint pain, muscle tightness and other issues due to
inflammation and are a favorite for massage therapy and reiki healing. Start by looking at the [Otto
128][41] and the [Om tuning fork][42].

## 乾いた心に
## 愛の波紋をお届けします。

凛舟（りんしゅう）は「厳しい寒さの中でもじっと耐え、進む舟」のイメージ。
人生という航海の中で、順風満帆な日もあれば、
荒波が押し寄せ、壊れそうになることも。
そんな時でも、
たとえいのちの最後の日であっても、
希望の光を届けられるものは何か。
真剣にそれを考えた時に、
私たちが出した答えがこの舟でした。

## Conceptコンセプト

### たった一人の
### 心・体・魂 の癒しのために

凛舟は、忙しい現代社会においてストレスの元にある方、さまざまな困難や病を抱える方、
また、そのような方々のケアに携わる方に、
心安らぐ日々をお届けすることを目指して開発されました。

[凛舟]

#### 音 おと
#### Sound

凛舟は、湾曲板による音の増幅を利用した画期的な音響・振動発生装置です（日米特許取得済）。湾曲板による
音の増幅は、実は昔から楽器の構造に生かされてきました。同じ方法で、帆から船体まで全てが振動する凛舟の
音は、生楽器の音のように可聴範囲外の超高域を豊かに含み、人間の耳の限界を遥かに超えて、体に伝わってく
るのです。世界最高水準の技術で作られた楽曲集がセットになっており、手に取ったその日から、美しい音をお
楽しみいただけます。

#### 技 わざ
#### Craftsmanship

船体には新潟産最高級の桐を使用。凛舟のためだけに山から原木を切り出し、2年をかけて熟成。帆には、1300
年の時を経てなお現存する法隆寺五重塔の建築にも使われている、木曽檜（ひのき）を使用しています。桐箪笥
の産地として知られる新潟・加茂の職人が、一台一台心を込めて丹念に製作。天然木と伝統工芸の粋を極めたこ
の芸術品は、年を重ねるごとに桐材の水分が抜け、バイオリンの如く、ますます美しく豊かな響きを持つように
なります。

#### 祈り いのり
#### Prayer

凛舟の奏でる楽曲は、私たちのビジョンに共感してくださる心ある演奏家の方々が、祈りのうちに心を込めて演
奏したものです。収録の前には、必ず祈りの時を持ち、この音源が誰に向けて、どのように使われるために作る
のかを共有。自己表現を捨て、ミスを恐れず「絵が見える」演奏を目指します。そうして奏でられた、注ぎ出す
ような祈りが、可聴帯域外の振動となって伝えられ、聴く方の心、体、魂に寄り添います。

年の時を経てなお現存する法隆寺五重塔の建築にも使われている、木曽檜（ひのき）を使用しています。桐箪笥
の産地として知られる新潟・加茂の職人が、一台一台心を込めて丹念に製作。天然木と伝統工芸の粋を極めたこ
の芸術品は、年を重ねるごとに桐材の水分が抜け、バイオリンの如く、ますます美しく豊かな響きを持つように
なります。

#### 祈り いのり
#### Prayer

凛舟の奏でる楽曲は、私たちのビジョンに共感してくださる心ある演奏家の方々が、祈りのうちに心を込めて演
奏したものです。収録の前には、必ず祈りの時を持ち、この音源が誰に向けて、どのように使われるために作る
のかを共有。自己表現を捨て、ミスを恐れず「絵が見える」演奏を目指します。そうして奏でられた、注ぎ出す
ような祈りが、可聴帯域外の振動となって伝えられ、聴く方の心、体、魂に寄り添います。

The Australian Sound Healers Association (ASHA) is a professional practitioner framework supporting
sound healing and sound therapy within a complementary wellbeing context.

ASHA provides structured practitioner pathways through professional standards, trauma-informed and
scope-based practice principles, practitioner certification pathways, membership recognition, and
directory support for both group and one-to-one practice settings.

We support practitioners through ethical frameworks, ongoing development, and structured
professional progression.

framework.

The Vibrational Sound® Association (VSA) focuses on the education of students in using unique
instruments such as singing bowls for sound therapy through teaching, workshops, and training.  The
VSA is dedicated to the continued evolution of the Vibrational Sound® Therapy (VST) modality.  The
continual input of teacher, practitioner, and client contribute to a partnership in furthering the
goals of the VSA. The Vibrational Sound® Association also acknowledges the importance of the tools
of the method - singing bowls, bells, tingshas, chimes, and gongs. The VSA seeks to further the use
of these ancient tools in a modern and structured modality that is an ordered and efficient
relaxation system.

Vibrational Sound® Therapy relies on specifically engineered Therapeutic Singing Bowls that provide
stress relief through extreme relaxation provided during the session. VST works through the actual
contact of the singing bowls and the human body. The modality is constantly growing and changing
with input from our community of practitioners, instructors, and clients. Using this information,
the method becomes a conscious living entity based on our therapeutic relationships.

The Vibrational Sound® Therapy instruction is provided through a set of workshops. Classes are
scheduled in advance and are available both domestically and abroad. Training ranges from two-day
basic instruction courses to full week long certification courses to multiple installment
instructors training.

This class is approved for CEU's for massage therapists from the National Certification Board for
Therapeutic Massage & Bodywork (NCBTMB).  Our 6 day certification class qualifies for 42 hours of
credit.

## FAQ

[More questions? ][106]

Which tuning fork set should I start with?

For beginners, and most holistic practitioners we recommend starting with the Sound Healing Starter
Set or Solfeggio Energy Tuners, as these sets are versatile and easy to use for general relaxation
and energy balancing.

For brain-focused work in a therapeutic setting, or for ASD work we recommend the Fibonacci Tuners
or the Brainwave Set for binaural beats.

For musicians looking to incorporate forks into their A432 Hz sessions we recommend the Fibonacci
set and any fork in the 432 Scale collection.

Can I use tuning forks on myself, or do I need a practitioner?

Yes, tuning forks can be used on yourself with proper technique, or just using your intuition! Watch
our videos throughout the site and sign up to our newsletter for upcoming workshops to teach you how
to use these forks for self-care and on others.

What is sound therapy or vibrational healing?

Sound therapy is a holistic healing practice that uses sound vibrations to promote physical,
emotional, and spiritual well-being. Vibrational healing refers to the use of specific frequencies
to balance the body’s energy fields. Every day we are honored to hear stories of the many ways this
work helps improve people's states of being.

What is the SomaEnergetics Energy Vitality Technique (EVT)?

The EVT is a specific method of using tuning forks to clear and balance energy pathways in the body.
It is designed to enhance vitality, reduce stress, and restore harmony. Learn more in our Legacy
Training Page.

* Current scientific studies on vibration therapy is very limited.
* There is no standardized, scientifically approved modalities, protocols and efficacy for specific
  applications.
* Vibration therapy should not be used as replacement for conventional physical therapy, exercise or

* Effectiveness varies depending on the type of vibration exercise machines, their parameters, and

* Not suitable for individuals with certain medical conditions.

## Risks & Hazards
* The potential risks of vibration therapy have not been thoroughly studied or well-documented.
  However, clinical trials suggest that when vibration plates are used correctly, they do not pose
  significant health hazards.
* While some users experience temporary side effects, these are generally not classified as serious
  risks..
* Risks and hazards can arise from using inappropriate equipment or performing exercises with
  improper technique.

## Scientific Studies

Scientific studies on vibration therapy has been gaining momentum in recent years.

Due to limited resources and a lack of commercial incentive, current clinical trials have not been
adequately designed to test a sufficient range of parameters and their combinations. Many trials
were not completed as designed, resulting in inconsistent results that fail to establish conclusion
regarding treatment modality in terms of parameters, procedure, dosage and efficacy.

Most other studies are rely on scientific rationale and literature reviews.

## Backed by science

Our vision at Advanced Brain Technologies is to transform the life of every person by offering them
programs for optimal brain health and functioning.

To fulfill our vision, we start with the scientific evidence that the brain has a natural ability to
physically change itself and strengthen its neural networks in response to a person’s experiences.
This is called neuroplasticity, and it occurs not just in childhood but throughout an individual’s
lifetime.

While the field of neuroscience only validated this concept in the last 20 years, our founder’s
family of human development pioneers observed this clinically in the mid-twentieth century. Experts
in brain injury rehabilitation and child development, they were among the first to develop
brain-training exercises to reorganize the brain and improve its performance. This is the foundation
The Listening Program® builds on today. But not just any brain games or music will do. Brain games
are just that—games to entertain. For music to make meaningful long-term changes, it should be
scientifically created to improve brain health and functioning.

## Hand-Selected Authentic Himalayan Singing Bowls

#### **Dear visitor,**

Thank you for choosing Bells of Bliss to explore the world of Tibetan, or Himalayan, singing bowls.
* We offer authentic, high-quality instruments, along with real guidance on how to use them well.
* Not every singing bowl on the market is worth owning — a lot of what's sold as "authentic" isn't,
  and even among genuine bowls, sound quality varies enormously.
* **Our job is to do the filtering for you. **
* Our collection includes individual singing bowls and matched sets, sourced from across the
  Himalayan region.
* Many of these instruments are decades or centuries old, and have passed through several owners
  before reaching us. When you look at the photos and listen to the sound samples, you're hearing a
  small piece of that history.
* Every bowl on this site was hand-selected from a much larger pool — hundreds of candidates for
  every one that makes it onto the site — evaluated specifically for sonic aesthetics. That's the
  one criterion we don't compromise on.
* If you have questions about choosing a bowl, we offer free consultations — just email or call, and
  we're glad to help.

**A quick note on terminology**: these instruments more accurately originate from the broader
Himalayan region, not Tibet specifically, so "Himalayan singing bowl" is the more precise term. We
use "Tibetan singing bowl" throughout the site as well, since that's the term most people search for
and are familiar with — but we wanted to be upfront about the distinction rather than let it go
unmentioned.

Calm is the #1 mental health app designed to help you manage stress, sleep better, and live a
happier, healthier life. Our research-based tools help you build life-changing habits to support
your mental health. If you're having trouble falling asleep, our 500+ [Sleep Stories][3]®,
soundscapes, and guided [sleep meditations][4] can lull you to sleep. If you're spiraling in
negative thoughts and need immediate relief, our 60-second Breathe Bubble grounds you in the moment
and helps your body return to a state of relaxation. If you're overwhelmed at work and need a
breather, our [stress and burnout specialists][5] can guide you through exercises to help calm your
mind. We're here for you whenever or wherever you need us with more content and tools being added
monthly.

What's included in a Calm subscription?

A Calm subscription unlocks our full library of [meditations][6], [Sleep Stories][7], [music][8],
and other features. The subscription includes:
* Multiple original [daily offerings][9] from a range of teachers to give your day a dose of wisdom,
  gratitude and encouragement

we recommend beginning with the [7 Days of Calm][13], our introductory program that offers the
basics of meditation, and then move on to the [21 Days of Calm][14]. With that foundation, you can
explore our library of sessions and programs, which address themes such as [anxiety][15],
[sleep][16], [focus][17], and [gratitude][18]. Additionally, for moments of acute stress or anxiety,
we offer in-the-moment calming exercises via our [Panic SOS][19], [Body Scan][20], and breathing
exercise features.

If you have come to Calm to improve your sleep, we have a collection of over 500 [Sleep Stories][21]
to help you drift off to restful sleep, ranging from [classic literature][22] to [nature
essays][23], [children's tales][24], scientific articles, and more. We update our Sleep Stories
selection with new options to listen to every week. We also have a collection of soothing Sleep
Music.

Calm is available on iOS, Android, Web, in addition to Apple TV, Apple Watch, Google WearOS, and

### MEDITATION & MINDFULNESS

What is meditation?

Meditation is the practice of allowing thoughts to come and go, as you learn to recognize and
release them without judgment. Studies show that a long-term meditation practice can actually help
shift your nervous system out of fight or flight and into the relaxed parasympathetic mode producing
a wide array of benefits* including:
* Decreased anxiety and depression symptoms
* Chronic pain management
* Lower stress levels
* Improved sleep quality

What is mindfulness?

Mindfulness is a practice that involves intentionally bringing one's attention and awareness to the
present moment without judgment. It's about being fully present and engaged in the here and now,
rather than dwelling on the past or worrying about the future. Mindfulness encourages a
non-judgmental attitude towards one's thoughts, emotions and sensations, allowing them to arise and
pass without any added stress. By cultivating mindfulness, people often develop a greater sense of
clarity, calmness and overall wellbeing, as well as enhance their ability to respond skillfully to
the challenges of life.

### STRESS & ANXIETY

What causes stress and anxiety?

Stress and anxiety can have various causes and can differ greatly from person to person. Here are a
few common factors that contribute to stress and anxiety:
1. Major life changes: Significant life events such as moving, getting married (or divorced),
   starting a new job or experiencing the loss of a loved one can trigger it.
2. Work or school pressure: High workloads, tight deadlines, challenging bosses, or work pressure
   can lead to stress and anxiety.
3. Financial challenges: Job loss, debt, or just struggling to make ends meet can be a significant
   source of stress and anxiety.
4. Relationships: Whether romantic, familial or social, strain or conflict in relationships can

## Hi, I’m *Nina Mua*.

“Corporate workers’ health is declining faster than ever, and most employees have never been taught
how their body and brain actually work under stress. That’s the gap we’re closing.”

I started Chakra Hours because wellness at work is failing the people who need it most. Employees
are exhausted, anxious, and short on sleep, and the typical answer is another app, another perk,
another newsletter. None of it teaches what’s actually happening in the nervous system on a Tuesday
at 2pm.

We treat wellbeing as education. How stress physiology works. Why your focus crashes mid-afternoon.
What to do, in 60 seconds, when overwhelm hits. Real techniques employees can use the same day they
learn them. (New to building a program? Start with our [ultimate guide to workplace wellness][18].)

Every session is science-informed and built on The Workday Reset Method™, a proven 4-pillar
framework. The whole program is designed to drop straight into a busy calendar, so a 30-minute live
class is all anyone has to commit.

### Music Therapy

Tailored sessions that utilise music to support communication, cognition, motor skills, mental
health and emotional well-being for people of all ages and abilities. Individual or group sessions
available.

Read details
Music Therapy

Music Therapy is a tool that can transform lives in big and small ways. It can be used with people
of any age or need and any musical ability. Music Therapy can support with communication, cognition
and emotional wellbeing amongst other things and our therapists tailor their support to your needs.
We work across England to provide services in person and digitally.

Click on the link below to see if we have a therapist near you. If you don’t see a therapist near

### Neurologic Music Therapy***®***

Evidence-based techniques aimed at assisting those with neurological conditions, focusing on
improving speech, cognition, and motor skills.
‍

Read details
Neurologic Music Therapy***®***

Neurologic Music Therapy® is a specialist form of music therapy that supports people of all ages
with brain injury and neuro-disabilities. Using specialist techniques we can use music to improve
speech, cognition, motor skills. Our therapists, also incorporate emotional health and well-being
into their sessions. We work across England to provide services in person and digitally.

Click on the link below to see if we have a specialist Neurologic Music Therapist near you. If you
don’t see a therapist near you, please do get in touch as we are always looking to expand our
services.

[View our locations][29][Who we work with][30]

### Community Music

Group sessions for individuals who enjoy music-making and singing, fostering community and joy with
those with similar needs.
‍

Read details
Community Music

Our community music groups are informal, welcoming spaces where people of all musical abilities can
come together to sing, make music and connect with others.

Each group focuses on a particular community, such as people living with Parkinson’s, dementia,
learning disabilities or mental health challenges, using shared music-making to support wellbeing,
connection and confidence.

### **How Does Edison Wave Work?**

Edison Wave works through a process known as brainwave entrainment, where rhythmic sound patterns
influence the brain’s natural electrical activity.

**1. The 11-Minute Alpha Soundwave Session
**
The program centers on a single daily listening session lasting approximately 11 minutes. During
this time, the audio delivers carefully structured frequencies designed to guide the brain toward
alpha wave activity.

The short duration is intentional. Research in auditory stimulation suggests that brief, repeated
exposure is often more effective for neural adaptation than long, irregular sessions.

**2. Frequency Following Response Explained Simply
**
The brain has a natural tendency to synchronize with external rhythmic stimuli. This is sometimes
referred to as the frequency following response. When exposed to consistent sound patterns, neural
activity may begin to align with the rhythm being presented.

In the case of Edison Wave, the soundwave is designed to encourage activity within the 8–12 Hz alpha
range, which is associated with efficient sensory processing and cognitive balance.

**3. Connection Between Alpha Waves and Auditory Perception
**
Auditory perception is not just about hearing sound but about how the brain prioritizes and
interprets it. When alpha activity is disrupted, the brain may become hyper focused on internal
signals.

By promoting alpha dominance, Edison Wave aims to support a more neutral relationship with sound.
This does not mean silence, but rather reduced emotional and attentional attachment to internal
noise.

**4. What Makes Edison Wave Different From Masking Tools
**
Most sound based tinnitus tools rely on masking, which means covering the ringing with external
noise. Once the noise stops, the tinnitus often returns unchanged.

Edison Wave is not a masking solution. It is a training based approach that focuses on changing how
the brain reacts to sound rather than hiding it temporarily.

# Deep Rest Through Sound Therapy in Singapore

A dedicated space for restorative soundbath sessions. Using Himalayan Singing Bowls and Gongs to
help settle the mind, heart and physical nervous system.

[ Book a Private Session ][37]

# The Relationship Between Sound and Wellbeing

Our bodies are not static; they are constantly responding to the environment around us. In a city
like Singapore, our nervous systems often remain in a state of "high alert."

Sound therapy acts as a bridge to balance. When we introduce the harmonic frequencies of handcrafted
Himalayan bowls, your body naturally begins to mirror these slower, steadier rhythms. This is a
process of nervous system regulation—shifting from a state of stress into one of alignment and
recovery.

Through intentional space holding and qualified, dedicated support, sound becomes a powerful
modality to:
* **Regulate the Nervous System:** Moving the body out of "fight or flight" and into a state of
  restorative rest.
* **Release Physical Bracing:** Helping the body let go of stored tension and mental "noise."
* **Support Deep Sleep:** Calming the mind to allow for natural, uninterrupted sleep cycles.

> **Research Insight:** Studies have shown that the specific overtones produced by[* Himalayan
> Singing Bowls can significantly reduce anxiety and improve sleep quality*][38].

  ## on Carrie's sounds and I could hear them all around me. I experienced vibrations down my back
  ## which amplified the therapeutic effect. Towards the end, I was gently roused out of the
  ## session, with a strong inclination to go to sleep. Highly recommended especially to those with
  ## sleeping issues.
  
  Siyun

  ## relaxing. It feels as though my body is no longer touching the floor. I felt very relaxed and
  ## recharged after the session. Then in my second session, I experienced vibrations down my back.
  ## It’s like having a massage. I also felt recharged after the session. In the 2nd session, Carrie
  ## used more types of instruments. I appreciate the effort she put in to choreograph the sound
  ## bath session using different instruments to achieve different results. Looking forward to more
  ## sound bath sessions with Carrie!

## Everything You Need To Feel Confident

Investing in wellness technology requires clarity. Here are the most common questions from people
considering VIBE for their home or practice.

How quickly will I feel results?

Most people notice relaxation and nervous system shifts during their first session. Deeper
transformations — improved sleep, reduced anxiety, trauma release — typically emerge between weeks
3–8 with consistent daily use. Think of it like physical therapy: one session feels good, but real
change comes from regular practice.

What's the difference between VIBE GO and VIBE PRO?

**VIBE GO ($5,500):** Compact, portable system with 2 transducers (200W). Perfect for home use,
travel, or mobile practitioners. Fits in a car and sets up in minutes.

**VIBE PRO ($6,500):** Full-size professional system with 4 transducers (300W). Delivers deeper,
more immersive therapy. Ideal for clinics, spas, and dedicated wellness spaces.

Both systems use the same NASA-studied frequencies and deliver full therapeutic benefits. The PRO
offers enhanced intensity and coverage.

Is VIBE safe? Are there any side effects?

VIBE is extremely safe and non-invasive. The therapy uses gentle vibrations (30–120 Hz) and sound
frequencies that naturally occur in the body. Most people experience zero side effects.

In rare cases, some users report temporary emotional release as stored trauma surfaces — this is
actually a sign the therapy is working. If you have a pacemaker, are pregnant, or have a seizure
disorder, consult your doctor first.

How long are sessions and how often should I use it?

Sessions typically range from 20–40 minutes. For optimal results we recommend daily 20-minute
sessions for stress management, or 3–5x per week minimum for long-term benefits. You can't overdo it
— many users fall asleep during sessions, which is perfectly fine.

What if VIBE doesn't work for me?

We offer a **30-day risk-free trial**. If VIBE isn't the right fit, return it for a full refund — no
questions asked. )We don't cover return shipping). We're confident because over 95% of people who
try VIBE keep it.

Do I need the VIBROPHILE app or can I use my own music?

You can use any audio source — Spotify, YouTube, audiobooks, silence. VIBE works with any sound via
Bluetooth or aux cable. However, the **VIBROPHILE app (included free)** features Dr. Schwartz's
proprietary psychoacoustic music engineered to synchronize with the vibrations for deeper nervous
system entrainment. Most users report significantly better results with the app.

Can multiple people use the same VIBE system?

Absolutely. VIBE is designed for multiple users — families, couples, clinic clients. Each person can
customize their session via the app or controller. We recommend using the included washable cover
between users for hygiene.

# The science of sound

### How Music Therapy & Sound Therapy Heals the Brain:

Music therapy is a professional field of practice that is offered worldwide in universities with
years of research exploring how music affects our physical, cognitive, mental and emotional health.
There are many studies showing that music listening and music making can help re-wire neuronal
pathways in the damaged brain, improve auditory processing in non-injured brains as well as,
regulate mood, and synchronize brain activity into relaxed states.

As a board-certified Music Therapist, with my Master’s degree in Music Therapy, I combine both music
therapy and sound therapy in my practice. I love discussing topics on the science of sound, so if
you want to learn more check out my podcasts on [Sound Meditation Radio][41].

# The science of sound

### How Music Therapy & Sound Therapy Heals the Brain:

Music therapy is a professional field of practice that is offered worldwide in universities with
years of research exploring how music affects our physical, cognitive, mental and emotional health.
There are many studies showing that music listening and music making can help re-wire neuronal
pathways in the damaged brain, improve auditory processing in non-injured brains as well as,
regulate mood, and synchronize brain activity into relaxed states.

As a board-certified Music Therapist, with my Master’s degree in Music Therapy, I combine both music
therapy and sound therapy in my practice. I love discussing topics on the science of sound, so if
you want to learn more check out my podcasts on [Sound Meditation Radio][41].

Music holds such power. It can unlock old memories and create new ones. It can unite strangers in
song. It is the soundtrack of our lives.

Music is also a remarkable tool that can stimulate the brain, develop new neural pathways, and spur
physical development.

**And through Music Therapy, music slows the effects of dementia, assists developmentally disabled
children learn to communicate, and helps adolescents learn coping skills.**

I invite you to explore how you or a loved one can experience the power of music through Music
Therapy.

Yes, making music is a talent that not all us possess. **But more importantly, music – whether we’re

I’ve seen happiness and joy on the faces of lost and confused dementia patients.

**And I’ve seen peace restored to families previously torn apart by the inability to communicate
with each other.**

I’ve seen powerful change through the power of music. And you can see it, too.

## What is Music Therapy?

Music Therapy is the clinical, evidence-based and non-medicinal use of music to accomplish
individualized goals within a therapeutic relationship by a credentialed professional who has
completed an approved Music Therapy program.


Music Therapy is an established health profession in which music is used to address physical,
emotional, cognitive, and social needs of individuals. 



Treatment may include creating, singing, moving to, and/or listening to music. **One does not need
to be a musician or have musical training to receive Music Therapy. **﻿

### Examples of changes we've seen through Music Therapy
* Promote wellness, mindfulness, and positive mental health
* Manage stress, anxiety, depression, and PTSD
* Alleviate pain
* Ease labor and childbirth
* Express feelings
* Minimize sleep disorders
* Enhance memory and retention
* Improve communication
* Promote physical rehabilitation
* Cope with the effects of abuse, trauma, and bullying
* Develop language and fine motor skills

### Who can benefit from Music Therapy?

Music Therapy provides avenues for communication that are helpful to those who find it difficult to
express themselves in words. 


People of all ages and of all walks of life have benefited from Music Therapy.

* Adults 
* Children and adolescents
* Veterans 
* Hospice/hospital patients

Treatment may include creating, singing, moving to, and/or listening to music. **One does not need
to be a musician or have musical training to receive Music Therapy. **﻿

### Examples of changes we've seen through Music Therapy
* Promote wellness, mindfulness, and positive mental health
* Manage stress, anxiety, depression, and PTSD
* Alleviate pain
* Ease labor and childbirth
* Express feelings
* Minimize sleep disorders
* Enhance memory and retention
* Improve communication
* Promote physical rehabilitation
* Cope with the effects of abuse, trauma, and bullying
* Develop language and fine motor skills

### Who can benefit from Music Therapy?

Music Therapy provides avenues for communication that are helpful to those who find it difficult to
express themselves in words. 


People of all ages and of all walks of life have benefited from Music Therapy.

* Adults 
* Children and adolescents
* Veterans 
* Hospice/hospital patients

### I highly recommend it

This device has really helped me clearly hear the TV dialogue while leaving the TV volume at a
reasonable level for others to hear. The IQbuds BOOST link very easily to the IQstream TV device.

I no longer require subtitles when watching TV and my wife can watch together without increased
volume from the TV. Also works well as a hands free phone device.

It has been an amazing change for both of us – husband can hear the TV and as he has told his
friends “choose not to hear me “ when l have had enough listening to the ? cricket ??

I have tried hearing aids that simply don’t work in many environments so I thought I’d try IQBoost
buds. They are more flexible in achieving a better result for my hearing problem and have the added
feature of allowing access to SIRI, phone calls and importantly my music library. They are so good I
purchased the IQStream product for TV listening. Now my wife likes them too.
**Colin B. from Australia**

### Great with the IQstream

I always needed to have the TV quite loud, but now this is in the past, especially with the IQstream
TV, the neighbors and my husband are delighted.
**Inge B. from Australia**

The IQstream TV/IQbuds Boost combination is a winner, vastly improving my movie viewing experience.
Sound is at ‘my’ level without bothering others and much clearer. The stereo is pretty amazing. I
had pretty much given up watching movies without captions, but with some movies now there is no
need, as I can actually hear the speech much more clearly. Of course the other benefit is I can
enjoy movies with the speakers muted so as to not bother other nearby who are not watching. Thank
you Nuheara for providing this technology at a reasonable price. An excellent value for money.
**Terry B. from United States**

# Welcome

### Vibrations of Serenity – Elevate Your Mind & Soul

Rana Singing Bowl Centre is a trusted manufacturer, trader, importer, and exporter of authentic
Tibetan and Himalayan handmade singing bowls, gongs, bells, tingshas, and Buddhist handicrafts.

Crafted by skilled artisans, our products are known for their deep resonance and lasting vibrations,
making them ideal for meditation, yoga, sound therapy, and holistic wellness. With a strong
commitment to quality and authenticity, we proudly serve spiritual centres, yoga studios, healers,
and collectors worldwide.

# ReSound Vivia

Discover how you can embrace the vividness of life with our latest hearing aids ReSound Vivia™,
which are smaller and more intelligent than ever.

[Explore ReSound Vivia][62]

### You can have it all with ReSound Enzo IA

With severe to profound hearing loss, environments with background noise are especially challenging.
But what if you could gain even more improvements without compromising on anything? Introducing
ReSound Enzo™ IA.

[Explore ReSound Enzo IA][63]

### ReSound Savi

ReSound Savi™ refines and combines our best-in-class technologies with our advanced features, giving
you clear sound, small designs, a natural fit and future-proof connectivity.

[Explore ReSound Savi][64]

#### Improve your quality of life

Life is so much more enjoyable when you can hear what’s going on around you. Our hearing aids can
help you get back the life you remember.

[ ReSound hearing aids ][65]
“These are the most comfortable hearing aids I have ever worn – I don’t even know they are there“
Wendy, aged 75, wildlife lover and community volunteer loves hiking, mushroom hunting, bird watching
and tending her bees. But a long- term, progressive hearing loss was beginning to dull her enjoyment
of nature. After finding Custom made by ReSound hearing aids she can once again recognize twenty
different birds from their song. Find out more about the benefits Custom made by ReSound could bring
to you.
[ Watch a real life story ][66]

# ABOUT SE7EN WAVES

At Se7en Waves Sound Vibes, we redefine relaxation through luxury sound healing experiences,
immersive sound baths, and holistic wellness services designed to restore the mind, body, and
nervous system. As a leading provider of sound baths in Texas and Colorado, we specialize in
elevated, multi-sensory experiences that guide busy professionals, wellness seekers, and corporate
teams out of stress and into deep relaxation and clarity.


We partner with luxury hotels, resorts, wellness retreats, and iconic venues to deliver
unforgettable sound bath experiences, floating sound baths, and corporate wellness events. From
Dallas-Fort Worth to Austin, Denver, and beyond, our experiences are curated for private events,
executive retreats, conferences, in-home sessions, and group wellness activations.


Our certified sound healing practitioners use a powerful blend of crystal singing bowls, Himalayan
bowls, gongs, chimes, flutes, and therapeutic sound frequencies to create a deeply restorative and
meditative environment. Each session is intentionally designed to support stress reduction, nervous
system regulation, emotional release, and mental clarity.


We go beyond traditional meditation by creating a fully immersive sensory journey:

 
* Taste | Infused waters enhance hydration and elevate the wellness experience.

 
* Smell | Chakra sprays, sage, and palo santo are incorporated to deepen relaxation and intention.

 
* Sight | Our sound baths are hosted in visually stunning, luxury environments that promote calm and
  presence.

 
* Touch | Floating sound baths, zero-gravity chairs, plush mats, and curated comfort elements allow
  the body to fully surrender.

 

Every Se7en Waves experience is crafted to help guests reset, recharge, and reconnect, offering one
of the most unique and sought-after sound healing experiences in the United States.


Whether you are an individual seeking deep restoration or a corporate wellness leader, event
planner, or luxury property looking to offer a premium wellness activation, Se7en Waves Sound Vibes
delivers an unmatched experience in luxury sound therapy and immersive relaxation.


Let go and flow. Rediscover the Art of Relaxation.

practitioner with over 14 years of experience. What began as a personal journey into sound has

nervous systems, and remember the wisdom their bodies have always held.


Our work spans from corporate wellness sessions with Infosys, JP Morgan, and Aditya Birla Group to
intimate sound baths, workshops, and comprehensive training programs. We believe sound is not just a
modality, it is a bridge between the body and mind, the noise of the outer world and the silence
within.

started teaching, sharing my passion for sound’s transformative power. I believe everyone has the
innate ability to heal, and I provide the guidance and support for that journey.

## About Sound Meditation India

Sound meditation India is a premier Yoga school and Research centre delivering knowledge on
authentic and traditional forms of Nada Yoga practices. It is an associate Centre of Indian Yoga
Association.

## What is sound meditation?

Sound meditation is a most effortless form of deep relaxation.

Sound meditation or Sound bath meditation as a part of Nada yoga is a science of exposing yourself
to sounds of particular frequencies that are conducive for the body and trigger the body's own
healing mechanism leading the body to homeostasis - making it disease free and help you achieve
higher states of consciousness.

Our Sound bath meditation are played in a specific manner to create relaxation and also guide
listeners on a journey of self discovery and inner exploration. Our playing style and the
instruments we use help relax the mind, body and nervous system. This results in a feeling of deep
relaxation and peace, expansion of consciousness, and numerous other benefits (especially when
experienced regularly).

Different instruments such as Crystal singing bowls, Tibetan singing bowls, gongs , Tingsha, om bell
are used as a part of the Sound meditation session. This helps one to feel a greater sense of
overall health and wellbeing.

#### Our Work as Sacred Sound Practitioners

We are custodians of ancient traditions, tasked with preserving and sharing the transformative power
of sound. Through the rhythmic pulse of drums, the resonant vibrations of gongs, and the soothing
tones of singing bowls, we facilitate profound experiences of healing, meditation, and
self-discovery.

During a session, we are conduits, guiding individuals and communities on journeys of personal
growth and spiritual awakening. With each drumbeat, each chime, we create sacred spaces where the
mundane and the transcendent converge, allowing participants to access deeper aspects of their
being.

Integral to our work is a deep reverence for the natural world and the interconnectedness of all
things. We draw inspiration from the rhythms of the earth, the cycles of the seasons, and the
harmonies of the cosmos.

As sound practitioners, we are teachers and catalysts for transformation. It is this sacred
responsibility that drives us, fueling our passion and dedication to our work. In a world
increasingly dominated by the cacophony of modern life, we offer respite, solace, and a pathway to
inner peace, using the language of sound to transcend the boundaries of the physical and access the
realms of the spirit. It is our honor to continue this timeless tradition, empowering others to
harness the transformative power of sound.

#### ***Galloping hooves, phases of the moon, speeding train, lapping waves, sunrise, sunset…***

Rhythm is a heartbeat at first.
Our mother’s commingling with our own.
Rhythm is breath and step.
It defines the day, the seasons, the year.

#### Our Work as Sacred Sound Practitioners

We are custodians of ancient traditions, tasked with preserving and sharing the transformative power
of sound. Through the rhythmic pulse of drums, the resonant vibrations of gongs, and the soothing
tones of singing bowls, we facilitate profound experiences of healing, meditation, and
self-discovery.

During a session, we are conduits, guiding individuals and communities on journeys of personal
growth and spiritual awakening. With each drumbeat, each chime, we create sacred spaces where the
mundane and the transcendent converge, allowing participants to access deeper aspects of their
being.

Integral to our work is a deep reverence for the natural world and the interconnectedness of all
things. We draw inspiration from the rhythms of the earth, the cycles of the seasons, and the
harmonies of the cosmos.

As sound practitioners, we are teachers and catalysts for transformation. It is this sacred
responsibility that drives us, fueling our passion and dedication to our work. In a world
increasingly dominated by the cacophony of modern life, we offer respite, solace, and a pathway to
inner peace, using the language of sound to transcend the boundaries of the physical and access the
realms of the spirit. It is our honor to continue this timeless tradition, empowering others to
harness the transformative power of sound.

#### ***Galloping hooves, phases of the moon, speeding train, lapping waves, sunrise, sunset…***

Rhythm is a heartbeat at first.
Our mother’s commingling with our own.
Rhythm is breath and step.
It defines the day, the seasons, the year.
We create & honor the rhythms of celebration: mealtime, TGIF, harvests, birth, marriage, death.
Rhythm is community, music, language.
It commits us.
It is impossible to resist.
Repetition, structure.
Pattern, tempo, echo.
Mathematical, ecological, teleological.
Universal and organic.
Feel it’s pulse, its purpose -
The perfection of existence.

#### Indications

ARCALYST^{®} (rilonacept) is an interleukin-1 blocker indicated for:
* Treatment of recurrent pericarditis (RP) and reduction in risk of recurrence in adults and
  pediatric patients 12 years and older.
* Treatment of Cryopyrin-Associated Periodic Syndromes (CAPS), including Familial Cold
  Auto-inflammatory Syndrome (FCAS), and Muckle-Wells Syndrome (MWS) in adults and children 12 years
  and older. 
* Maintenance of remission of Deficiency of Interleukin-1 Receptor Antagonist (DIRA) in adults and
  pediatric patients weighing 10 kg or more.

  infections. Serious infections, including life-threatening infections and death, have happened in
  patients taking ARCALYST. If you have any signs of an infection, call your doctor right away.
  Treatment with ARCALYST should be stopped if you get a serious infection. You should not begin
  treatment with ARCALYST if you have an infection or have infections that keep coming back (chronic
  infection).
* While taking ARCALYST, do not take other medicines that block interleukin-1, such as Kineret®
  (anakinra), or medicines that block tumor necrosis factor, such as Enbrel® (etanercept), Humira®
  (adalimumab), or Remicade® (infliximab), as this may increase your risk of getting a serious
  infection.

# Integrating Educational Leadership with Restorative Wellness

## *Root and Resonance Collective helps individuals, schools, and communities thrive through expert
## consulting and wellness experiences.*

[Book Educational Сonsulting][25][Book Sound Therapy][26]

## What We Do

We provide a menu of supports for organizational growth and resilience through two specialized
pillars.

Pillar 1: Systems Design & Professional Learning

Our Partnership Focus: Assessing organizational readiness and strengthening Professional Learning
Communities (PLCs).

The Intent: To cultivate collective efficacy and sustainable growth. We help align organizational
practices with inclusive standards and best practices to ensure your systems support the students
and people within them.

### Pillar 2: Restorative Sound & Wellness Experiences

Our Partnership Focus: Utilizing sound therapy as a restorative pathway to regulate the nervous
system, sustaining leadership longevity and manage the physical toll of leadership.

The Intent: To create a dedicated space for educators and leaders to transition from “survival mode”
back to a state of clarity and wholeness.

## Our Mission & Purpose

Dr. Ann Veu’s career in education spans over 20 years, from her foundations in the classroom to a
decade spent training teachers and school leaders at the site, district and county level.

Throughout this journey, she saw a recurring theme: brilliant educators struggling to show up as
their best selves due to systemic burnout. She realized that professional development alone wasn't
enough; restoring professional capacity requires a deeper level of nervous system regulation.

Today, we partner with schools and organizations to evaluate organizational readiness and strengthen
teacher collaboration. By integrating trauma-informed leadership with restorative wellness, we help
adults recenter, recover, and lead with wholeness.

# THE BEST COWORKING SPACE IN DEVON.

TIRED OF WORKING FROM HOME?

[Coworking Devon open plan space]

## are you an employer?

Forget added bills, utilities, business insurance and rates. Use our Employer plan for your staff
and save 25%.

[Employer Plans ][31]

James A Photography

CoWorking Devon is a growing coworking space in Buckfastleigh. We are here for the new business
starters, the small business owners and the flexible remote employees that need community - we're
also totally dog friendly too. Inside our light-filled coworking space you’ll find a vibrant
community of entrepreneurs and innovators drawn here by the desire to connect, collaborate and
create. Venture outside, as we often do, and you’ll find ancient woodland and the River Dart, home
to an elusive population of local otters and the frequent blue flashes of kingfishers in flight. 


Meet us in a place where work and wellbeing strikes a better balance. 

[About CWD ][32]

## A CoWorking space with more to offer

Our riverside coworking space is designed for all kinds of freelancers, small businesses and
employees seeking a more inspiring place to work. We offer a range of spaces, from single desks in
our open-plan studio to private offices. In summer, our gallery windows bring the great outdoors in.
In winter kiln-dried birch crackles in the fireplace. 

We have a cracking selection of tea and coffee, and we always have a lovely selection of the best
Pukka teas you can find - including all the decafe's, on-demand screens and copious amounts of
cables, a free A4/A3 printer, mice, keyboards, headphones, laptop stands, microphones and even
charging cables and ethernet adaptors! CoWorking Devon has everything you need for networking,
brainstorming, making new connections or just knuckling down and getting the job done.

employed (and paying the fee yourself) or self-employed, you can make a tax claim. BAMT is
officially listed under ['Approved professional organisations and learned societies'][91] on the
HMRC website.

• This also includes your registration fee with the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC).

Professional Fees and Subscriptions][92] - Refer to the list under "M" for Music Therapy British

## Sound Therapy Healing Practitioners Around the World

The International Sound Therapy Association (ISTA) is comprised of individuals interested in the
benefits of sound and vibration including but not limited to: sound therapists, musicians, healing
practitioners, music therapists and medical professionals. Speakers and performers connect with
other like-minded individuals & organizations. ISTA is dedicated to increasing awareness of sound
healing techniques through community and educational outreach, workshops, concerts and conferences.
Read our Mission Statement below and see how ISTA can benefit you!

## Get Involved with ISTA

ISTA offers three great ways to join our mission. We are honored to be supported by direct tax
deductible donations, associate memberships or by becoming an ISTA Certified Therapeutic Sound
Practitioner. Learn more below!

## Harness the Power of Sound

Sound is all around you. Come explore the incredible benefits of therapeutic sound application.
Sound is emerging as one of the most powerful modalities to help improve overall wellness and
specific conditions. 

[Join Us!][60]

## Mission Statement

The International Sound Therapy Association’s purpose is to promote the benefits of therapeutic
sound by providing an educational forum and activities for sound therapists, musicians, healing arts
practitioners, and the general public.

ISTA provides a local forum for the dissemination and sharing of leading edge educational
information and research on sound therapy modalities and new ways to use ancient therapies, in order
to advance the understanding of the therapeutic benefits of music, sound and vibration.

Join us in our mission to bring more peace, joy and wellness to the world through the powerful
modality of therapeutic sound application.

## Sound Therapy Healing Practitioners Around the World

The International Sound Therapy Association (ISTA) is comprised of individuals interested in the
benefits of sound and vibration including but not limited to: sound therapists, musicians, healing
practitioners, music therapists and medical professionals. Speakers and performers connect with
other like-minded individuals & organizations. ISTA is dedicated to increasing awareness of sound
healing techniques through community and educational outreach, workshops, concerts and conferences.
Read our Mission Statement below and see how ISTA can benefit you!

Sound is all around you. Come explore the incredible benefits of therapeutic sound application.
Sound is emerging as one of the most powerful modalities to help improve overall wellness and
specific conditions.

## Mission Statement

The International Sound Therapy Association’s purpose is to promote the benefits of therapeutic
sound by providing an educational forum and activities for sound therapists, musicians, healing arts
practitioners, and the general public.

ISTA provides a local forum for the dissemination and sharing of leading edge educational
information and research on sound therapy modalities and new ways to use ancient therapies, in order
to advance the understanding of the therapeutic benefits of music, sound and vibration.

## Explore Therapy Technologies & Devices

### Focused Shockwave Therapy

Focused shockwave therapy delivers concentrated acoustic energy into targeted tissue areas, making
it suitable for deep musculoskeletal conditions, chronic pain, tendon injuries, and precise
rehabilitation applications.
[ View Devices ][77] [ Learn Technology ][78]

### Radial Shockwave Therapy

Radial shockwave therapy spreads acoustic energy across a broader treatment area, making it ideal
for superficial pain, muscle tension, myofascial conditions, and sports recovery treatments.
[ View Devices ][79] [ Learn Technology ][80]

### Magneto Therapy

Magneto therapy uses pulsed electromagnetic fields to stimulate deeper tissues, support pain
management, improve recovery, and assist rehabilitation for muscles, joints, tendons, and soft
tissue conditions.
[ View Devices ][81] [ Learn Technology ][82]

### Laser Therapy

Laser therapy delivers therapeutic light energy to support tissue repair, reduce discomfort, improve
circulation, and assist recovery in physical therapy and rehabilitation settings.
[ View Devices ][83] [ Learn Technology ][84]

### Tecar Therapy

TECAR therapy uses capacitive and resistive radiofrequency energy to stimulate deep tissues, improve
circulation, support soft tissue recovery, and enhance rehabilitation efficiency.
[ View Devices ][85] [ Learn Technology ][86]

### Ultrasound Therapy

Ultrasound therapy uses high-frequency sound waves to penetrate soft tissues, support tissue
healing, relieve pain, and improve circulation in clinical physiotherapy applications.
[ View Devices ][87] [ Learn Technology ][88]

## Home

How does music as sound and vibration impact your body and brain?

Dr. Lee Bartel explores how sound can stimulate cells in your body and brain to reduce the impact of
Fibromyalgia pain, Alzheimer’s Disease, Parkinson’s Disease, Depression, and even increase blood
flow. It shows how a common consumer vibroacoustic device is used to treat these health conditions.
Lee Bartel is Professor Emeritus of Music and Health and Music Education and at the University of
Toronto and Member of the Board and Chair of the Research and Education Committee for the Artists’
Health Alliance. He served as Faculty of Music Associate Dean of Research, and was the Founding
Director of the Music and Health Research Collaboratory (MaHRC) at University of Toronto from 2011 –
2015.

He is a Member of the Collaborative Program in Neuroscience, Cross-appointed to Institute for Life
Course and Aging, as well as the Graduate Department of Rehabilitation Science. He taught graduate
courses on Music and Brain as well as Social Psychology of Music. With extensive early experience as
a music teacher at all levels and as a performing choral conductor, singer, violinist, and
guitarist, he has special interest in conditions of learning, pedagogic culture, social psychology,
and music in human development. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format
but independently organized by a local community.

a music teacher at all levels and as a performing choral conductor, singer, violinist, and
guitarist, he has special interest in conditions of learning, pedagogic culture, social psychology,
and music in human development. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format
but independently organized by a local community.

[[Music Therapy Makes a Difference]][83]

## Music Therapy Makes a Difference

Music Therapy is an established health profession in which music is used within a therapeutic
relationship to address physical, emotional, cognitive, and social needs of individuals. Click the
picture to learn more.

[[What is the Profession of Music Therapy?]][84]

## What is the Profession of Music Therapy?

Music Therapy is the clinical & evidence-based use of music interventions to accomplish
individualized goals within a therapeutic relationship by a credentialed professional who has
completed an approved music therapy program. Click to learn more.

[[How Does Music Therapy Work?]][85]

## How Does Music Therapy Work?

Music therapy interventions can address a variety of healthcare & educational goals: Promote
Wellness, Manage Stress, Alleviate Pain, Express Feelings, Enhance Memory, Improve Communication,
Promote Physical Rehabilitation, etc. Click to learn more.

[[Is Music Therapy Effective?]][86]

## Is Music Therapy Effective?

Research in music therapy supports its effectiveness in a wide variety of healthcare and educational
settings. Click the picture to learn more.

[[Where Do Music Therapists Work?]][87]

## Where Do Music Therapists Work?

Music therapists work in medical hospitals, treatment centers, psychiatric hospitals, schools,
community mental health centers, drug & alcohol programs, senior centers, nursing homes, hospice
programs, correctional facilities & more. Click to learn more.

[[What Do Music Therapists Do?]][88]

## What Do Music Therapists Do?

Music therapists assess emotional well-being, physical health, social functioning, communication
abilities, & cognitive skills through musical responses; design music interventions for individuals
and groups based on client needs; & follow up progress.

[[Who is Qualified to Practice Music Therapy?]][89]

## Who is Qualified to Practice Music Therapy?

[[Where Do Music Therapists Work?]][87]

Music therapists work in medical hospitals, treatment centers, psychiatric hospitals, schools,

and groups based on client needs; & follow up progress.

[[Who is Qualified to Practice Music Therapy?]][89]

## Who is Qualified to Practice Music Therapy?

Those who complete an approved music therapy degree, internship, and who pass the Certification
Board for Music Therapists' certifying exam, earning the credential MT-BC (Music Therapist, Board
Certified). Click the picture to learn more.

[[Who Can Benefit from Music Therapy?]][90]

## Who Can Benefit from Music Therapy?

Children, adolescents, adults, & the elderly with mental health needs, developmental & learning
disabilities, Alzheimer's disease, aging related conditions, substance abuse problems, brain
injuries, physical disabilities, acute and chronic pain, & more.

[[Does Research Support Music Therapy?]][91]

## Does Research Support Music Therapy?

AMTA promotes a vast amount of research exploring the benefits of music as therapy through
publication two research journals and other sources. A substantial body of literature exists to
support its effectiveness. Click the picture to learn more.

[[What is AMTA's Mission?]][92]

## What is AMTA's Mission?

The mission of the American Music Therapy Association is to advance public awareness of the benefits
of music therapy and increase access to quality music therapy services in a rapidly changing world.

**Sound Risings **grew out of my lifelong dedication to helping people create meaningful, lasting
change.
I’m Karen Stephenson, a sound therapist, educator, and facilitator of transformational group work.
My work blends the science of neuroplasticity with the art of vibrational healing, helping clients
calm their bodies, rewire thought patterns, and reconnect with their truest selves.

I offer** individual and group sound therapy appointments** in **Central Massachusetts **and, when
in **New Jersey**, at** Well In Montclair Wellness Cente**r—a space owned by my sister, Cathy
Stephenson, a physical therapist, coach, and Traditional Chinese Medicine practitioner.

combines the wisdom of the Five Elements of Traditional Chinese Medicine with modern neuroscience
and vibrational practices. I facilitate QAM™-based group transformations, guiding participants
through a deep process of rewiring patterns, restoring balance, and stepping into aligned living.

infused with the healing power of sound. Here, you’ll find a safe, welcoming space to explore who
you are becoming—supported by tools that help you sustain change long after the session ends.

At **Sound Rising** we combine scientific research, sound-based techniques, and proven coaching
strategies to support meaningful, lasting change:

**At Sound Risings, we believe:**
* Healing begins with self-awareness—your brain is wired for change, and awareness is the first step
  to rewiring old patterns.
* Sound and energy therapy unlock deep transformation—science-backed vibrational healing shifts your
  biofield, clears limiting beliefs, and enhances neuroplasticity
* Coaching provides the roadmap to lasting alignment—by integrating brain science, spirituality, and
  action-driven coaching, we help you bridge the gap between where you are and your highest
  potential.

  spiritual trust. When you align your energy, shift your mindset, and take inspired action, the
  life you desire becomes inevitable.

Join me in this journey of self-discovery and alignment. Let’s rewire your mind, amplify your
energy, and co-create a life of abundance, purpose, and gratitude.

## Every transformation begins with someone who can hold space for your journey. As a sound

## healing, education, and leadership—helping people in both New Jersey and Massachusetts create
## lasting, life-changing shifts.

### What is WFMT?

The **World Federation of Music Therapy **(WFMT)** **is an **international nonprofit organization
**bringing together **music therapy** associations and individuals interested in developing and
promoting music therapy globally through the exchange of information, collaboration among
professionals, and actions.

**Founded in 1985 in Genoa**, Italy, it is the only worldwide professional organization representing
music therapy in many areas of the world. The members of the Federation are music therapy
organizations, training programs, certified music therapists, music therapy students, and
individuals associated with music therapy.

WFMT is an international body, with officers, commissioners, and regional liaisons in all regions of
the world.

### What is WFMT?

The **World Federation of Music Therapy **(WFMT)** **is an **international nonprofit organization
**bringing together **music therapy** associations and individuals interested in developing and
promoting music therapy globally through the exchange of information, collaboration among
professionals, and actions.

**Founded in 1985 in Genoa**, Italy, it is the only worldwide professional organization representing
music therapy in many areas of the world. The members of the Federation are music therapy
organizations, training programs, certified music therapists, music therapy students, and
individuals associated with music therapy.

WFMT is an international body, with officers, commissioners, and regional liaisons in all regions of
the world.

The Vibrational Sound® Association (VSA) focuses on the education of students in using unique
instruments such as singing bowls for sound therapy through teaching, workshops, and training.  The
VSA is dedicated to the continued evolution of the Vibrational Sound® Therapy (VST) modality.  The
continual input of teacher, practitioner, and client contribute to a partnership in furthering the
goals of the VSA. The Vibrational Sound® Association also acknowledges the importance of the tools
of the method - singing bowls, bells, tingshas, chimes, and gongs. The VSA seeks to further the use
of these ancient tools in a modern and structured modality that is an ordered and efficient
relaxation system.

Vibrational Sound® Therapy relies on specifically engineered Therapeutic Singing Bowls that provide
stress relief through extreme relaxation provided during the session. VST works through the actual
contact of the singing bowls and the human body. The modality is constantly growing and changing
with input from our community of practitioners, instructors, and clients. Using this information,
the method becomes a conscious living entity based on our therapeutic relationships.

The Vibrational Sound® Therapy instruction is provided through a set of workshops. Classes are
scheduled in advance and are available both domestically and abroad. Training ranges from two-day
basic instruction courses to full week long certification courses to multiple installment
instructors training.

This class is approved for CEU's for massage therapists from the National Certification Board for
Therapeutic Massage & Bodywork (NCBTMB).  Our 6 day certification class qualifies for 42 hours of
credit.

The Vibrational Sound® Association (VSA) focuses on the education of students in using unique
instruments such as singing bowls for sound therapy through teaching, workshops, and training.  The
VSA is dedicated to the continued evolution of the Vibrational Sound® Therapy (VST) modality.  The
continual input of teacher, practitioner, and client contribute to a partnership in furthering the
goals of the VSA. The Vibrational Sound® Association also acknowledges the importance of the tools
of the method - singing bowls, bells, tingshas, chimes, and gongs. The VSA seeks to further the use
of these ancient tools in a modern and structured modality that is an ordered and efficient
relaxation system.

Vibrational Sound® Therapy relies on specifically engineered Therapeutic Singing Bowls that provide
stress relief through extreme relaxation provided during the session. VST works through the actual
contact of the singing bowls and the human body. The modality is constantly growing and changing
with input from our community of practitioners, instructors, and clients. Using this information,
the method becomes a conscious living entity based on our therapeutic relationships.

The Vibrational Sound® Therapy instruction is provided through a set of workshops. Classes are
scheduled in advance and are available both domestically and abroad. Training ranges from two-day
basic instruction courses to full week long certification courses to multiple installment
instructors training.

This class is approved for CEU's for massage therapists from the National Certification Board for
Therapeutic Massage & Bodywork (NCBTMB).  Our 6 day certification class qualifies for 42 hours of
credit.

## Backed by science

Our vision at Advanced Brain Technologies is to transform the life of every person by offering them
programs for optimal brain health and functioning.

To fulfill our vision, we start with the scientific evidence that the brain has a natural ability to
physically change itself and strengthen its neural networks in response to a person’s experiences.
This is called neuroplasticity, and it occurs not just in childhood but throughout an individual’s
lifetime.

While the field of neuroscience only validated this concept in the last 20 years, our founder’s
family of human development pioneers observed this clinically in the mid-twentieth century. Experts
in brain injury rehabilitation and child development, they were among the first to develop
brain-training exercises to reorganize the brain and improve its performance. This is the foundation
The Listening Program® builds on today. But not just any brain games or music will do. Brain games
are just that—games to entertain. For music to make meaningful long-term changes, it should be
scientifically created to improve brain health and functioning.

[READ OUR RESEARCH][46]

# Get started by discovering solutions and benefits for you

We are here to help you optimize your brain’s functioning and health, offering a wide range of
benefits and solutions to issues from executive function deficits to sleep difficulties.

Learning Focus Communication Sensory Processing Sleep Stress Management Memory Social & Emotional
Executive Function Rehabilitation Problem Solving Motor Skills Wellness Creative Expression

### Learning

**Strengthen skills for learning **

Self-awareness, memory, focus, and mental flexibility are all necessary for learning in a classroom,
rehabilitation after an illness or injury—and for everyone as part of everyday life. Thanks to
neuroplasticity, the brain can develop new neural networks and strengthen old ones throughout an
individual’s lifetime, making us all lifetime learners.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is music therapy?

Music therapy, an allied health profession, "is the clinical and evidence-based use of music
interventions to accomplish individualized goals within a therapeutic relationship by a credentialed
professional who has completed an approved music therapy program."

What are the health benefits of music therapy?

Music therapy is used to aid in physical discomfort by improving respiration, lowering blood
pressure, improved cardiac output, reduced heart rate and relaxed muscle tension.

What are the limitations of music therapy?

Music therapy is generally very safe and has no side effects. But very loud music or particular
types of music might irritate some people or make them feel uncomfortable. The music might trigger
strong reactions or evoke memories which could range from pleasant to painful.

What kind of music is used in music therapy?

Songs by Queen, Pink Floyd and Bob Marley are among the most effective for music therapy patients, a
UK study has found.

  pediatric patients weighing 10 kg or more.

Claim your Tax Relief now!
Did you know you could be eligible to claim tax relief on your BAMT membership fees? Whether you are
employed (and paying the fee yourself) or self-employed, you can make a tax claim. BAMT is
officially listed under ['Approved professional organisations and learned societies'][91] on the
HMRC website.
Who Can Claim?
• Members who have personally paid their BAMT membership fees within the past four years.
• This also includes your registration fee with the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC).
How to Claim Your Tax Relief:
For detailed guidance on claiming tax relief, please visit: [HMRC Guidance on Tax Relief for
Professional Fees and Subscriptions][92] - Refer to the list under "M" for Music Therapy British
Association (BAMT).

For claiming tax relief on your HCPC registration fee, please check [THIS PAGE][93].

## Hand-Selected Authentic Himalayan Singing Bowls

#### **Dear visitor,**

Thank you for choosing Bells of Bliss to explore the world of Tibetan, or Himalayan, singing bowls.
* We offer authentic, high-quality instruments, along with real guidance on how to use them well.
* Not every singing bowl on the market is worth owning — a lot of what's sold as "authentic" isn't,
  and even among genuine bowls, sound quality varies enormously.
* **Our job is to do the filtering for you. **
* Our collection includes individual singing bowls and matched sets, sourced from across the
  Himalayan region.
* Many of these instruments are decades or centuries old, and have passed through several owners
  before reaching us. When you look at the photos and listen to the sound samples, you're hearing a
  small piece of that history.
* Every bowl on this site was hand-selected from a much larger pool — hundreds of candidates for
  every one that makes it onto the site — evaluated specifically for sonic aesthetics. That's the
  one criterion we don't compromise on.
* If you have questions about choosing a bowl, we offer free consultations — just email or call, and
  we're glad to help.

**A quick note on terminology**: these instruments more accurately originate from the broader
Himalayan region, not Tibet specifically, so "Himalayan singing bowl" is the more precise term. We
use "Tibetan singing bowl" throughout the site as well, since that's the term most people search for
and are familiar with — but we wanted to be upfront about the distinction rather than let it go
unmentioned.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### GENERAL

What is Calm?

Calm is the #1 mental health app designed to help you manage stress, sleep better, and live a
happier, healthier life. Our research-based tools help you build life-changing habits to support
your mental health. If you're having trouble falling asleep, our 500+ [Sleep Stories][3]®,
soundscapes, and guided [sleep meditations][4] can lull you to sleep. If you're spiraling in
negative thoughts and need immediate relief, our 60-second Breathe Bubble grounds you in the moment
and helps your body return to a state of relaxation. If you're overwhelmed at work and need a
breather, our [stress and burnout specialists][5] can guide you through exercises to help calm your
mind. We're here for you whenever or wherever you need us with more content and tools being added
monthly.

What's included in a Calm subscription?

A Calm subscription unlocks our full library of [meditations][6], [Sleep Stories][7], [music][8],
and other features. The subscription includes:
* Multiple original [daily offerings][9] from a range of teachers to give your day a dose of wisdom,
  gratitude and encouragement
* Hours of [guided meditations][10] covering sleep, anxiety, stress, gratitude, and much more
* Our entire library of more than 500+ [Sleep Stories][11], with new stories added every week
* Exclusive [music][12] tracks for focus, relaxation, and sleep

Where should I get started once I download the app?

If you have come to Calm to learn relaxation techniques and improve aspects of your mental health,
we recommend beginning with the [7 Days of Calm][13], our introductory program that offers the
basics of meditation, and then move on to the [21 Days of Calm][14]. With that foundation, you can
explore our library of sessions and programs, which address themes such as [anxiety][15],
[sleep][16], [focus][17], and [gratitude][18]. Additionally, for moments of acute stress or anxiety,
we offer in-the-moment calming exercises via our [Panic SOS][19], [Body Scan][20], and breathing
exercise features.

If you have come to Calm to improve your sleep, we have a collection of over 500 [Sleep Stories][21]
to help you drift off to restful sleep, ranging from [classic literature][22] to [nature
essays][23], [children's tales][24], scientific articles, and more. We update our Sleep Stories
selection with new options to listen to every week. We also have a collection of soothing Sleep
Music.

What devices support the Calm app?

Calm is available on iOS, Android, Web, in addition to Apple TV, Apple Watch, Google WearOS, and
Samsung Health.

How do I cancel?

You can cancel your Calm subscription's auto-renewal or free trial at any time.

2. Tap the 'Settings' gear icon in the top left corner of your screen.
3. Tap 'Manage Subscription' and follow the instructions here to cancel your subscription.
